items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 1.8% in 1985 to 2.4% in 2025 across 54 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

31 of 54 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 37 for salt or chloride; 3 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 54 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 7 of 7 high-need ones have none.
